title: Post-hardening end-to-end worker proof
objective: Prove a fresh GPT-5.6 Sol worker can register, atomically claim an exclusive slot, wait for validated-state fencing to catch up, create its branch, and open a PR that passes the hardened trusted-base claim/worker/branch/scope/digest gate.
acceptance: worker registration is present on live control state
exclusive claim is atomically created before branch creation
generated validation marker matches the exact authoritative live-state digest after claim
PR ownership job uses hardening validator from trusted base main
canonical CI passes and proof PR merges
claim is released and worker is stopped afterward
